cost: Parsing has a linear input baseline; formatting adds repeated segment/flag scans up to O(format length * expanded atoms) and output allocation. Table key discovery/lookup can cost O(rows*keys^2). VFS/import/export and interpreter costs are delegated; external subprocess and frozen-suite costs remain unmeasured and unexecuted.

CLI make_fs imports before Interp.run; finish_fs exports only on ok, then journal. Selected fs tests invoke this CLI on temporary synthetic data; Octave and VMM harnesses contribute only bounded selector/hash-helper evidence.

builtins/mod registers files/io; io calls display::format_disp and exp_str; fileio uses table inference/date/name adapters and column-major Mat; main creates Interp with selected fs and selected tests/fs CLI helper observes exit/stdout/stderr/journal/files. sprintf column-major traversal and display row layout are different adapters; JSON orientation/nonfinite loss prevents identity roundtrip. Octave calls lexical filter is not parser validation, and VMM digest helper evidence is not scenario correctness.
inverse: Interp failure excludes CLI export_dir but permits journal and previous imports; VFS error with requested status excludes throw for mkdir/rmdir/move/copy. J::Num/numeric-class nonfinite conversion excludes the original numeric literal; logical NaN instead converts to true under the nonzero predicate. No runtime scenario guarantee follows from helper checks.

Printed output maps to sets of Value/format antecedents, serialization admits missing/null and shape ambiguities, exit codes admit multiple failure stages. Joint journal and filesystem observations narrow compatible histories but do not reconstruct all interpreter steps.
limitations: VMM400 frozen scenarios and known-red baseline unchanged and unexecuted
External Octave orchestration unexecuted; helper evidence only

state: Memory is default CLI/interpreter backend; file builtins do not bypass it. Formatting and serialization themselves perform no filesystem writes. Failed interpreter status suppresses CLI export; successful finalization is required for exit0. Test helpers use bounded synthetic data and frozen baselines stay unchanged.
